messages:
sam: FYI we pushed the SDK v2.0 docs refresh and a migration guide for breaking API changes. Please review for any missing examples before I turn on the in-console banner.
joan: Nice. Which breaking changes should support and integrations teams expect?
sam: Short list: 1) `generate()` (sync) is removed in favor of `create_completion()` which returns a promise/async iterator. 2) `prompt` param renamed to `input`. 3) embeddings endpoint param `size` -> `dimensions`. 4) we standardized the error model (error.id, error.code) which means some legacy 5xx/429 parsing will change.
lina: Can you paste the old vs new usage sample for generate -> create_completion? That helps sample apps.
sam: Sure. Old (v1):
```
// v1 sync-style
const res = client.generate({ model: 'rwd-1b', prompt: 'summarize x' });
console.log(res.text);
```
New (v2):
```
// v2 async-style
for await (const chunk of client.create_completion({ model: 'rwd-1b', input: 'summarize x' })) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.delta);
}
```
kevin: Heads-up: streaming chunk shape changed — each chunk now includes meta `{cursor, delta, done}`. Add to the quickstart.
joan: We need to update SDK changelog, quickstarts, and the examples repo. I can handle quickstarts.
sam: There
re also telemetry behavior changes: SDKs will opt-in to unified request telemetry (payload hashes, timings) by default; customers can opt out via `telemetry: false` in client config. Add privacy blurb in docs.
lina: Good call to highlight opt-out. Legal asked I add the exact config snippet and link to the privacy page.
kevin: Any codemods? A codemod would save customers a lot of time refactoring `prompt` -> `input`.
sam: Yes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-migrations/tree/main/v2-codemods includes JS and Py codemods for input/size renames and error-shape updates.
docs-bot: Migration guide live: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdks/v2-migration - includes codemod instructions, sample diffs, and deprecation schedule.
joan: Timeline suggestion: announce now, warnings in 45 days, APIs disabled for new tokens in 90 days, full removal for existing tokens in 150 days. Does that align with product?
sam: Product OK with that cadence. We'll keep a runtime compatibility shim for 150 days to allow enterprise exception requests.
kevin: SRE: please add streaming-chunk-size and error-parse-fail metrics to the dashboard during rollout. Also watch for a bump in 500s when clients upgrade.
joan: I'll prepare the customer-facing banner + support template. Want the banner staged behind a feature flag so we can rollback quickly.
sam: Agreed. Also adding a small note in the console SDK version selector about the major bump.
docs-bot: Changelog PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/312 - release notes, migration checklist, and sample code updated.
lina: Thanks everyone. Im going to sweep the snippets for language parity (Go + Py + JS) and open a follow-up if anything missing.
__notes: Simulated Slack thread: SDK v2.0 docs refresh + migration discussion. Single continuous messages string per agents.md. No title field included.
